inShort: A dinks steadily to the middle, and B changes something on every dink until A pops one up. After 5 points, swap roles.
rules: A and B dink at the kitchen line, cross-court or straight. A keeps the rhythm, B tries to break it.
A dinks steadily, always to the middle of B's half.
B changes something on every ball: outside foot, inside foot, low over the net, out of the air, slice, topspin.
B may play down the line only after two cross-court dinks.
Every pop-up or miss by A is a point for B.
After 5 points, swap roles. Whoever forced more pop-ups wins.
tooEasy: Both of you change something on every ball at once: no steady player, just read and react.
tooHard: B calls the change out loud before the dink, for example "Wide!", so A can set up for it.
goodLooksLike: A has to move and adjust on every ball, and B's dinks still stay low.
